milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cobwebs are placed on the corridor upper walls at spawn-relative z=5-7, heights y+2 and y+3. Target is the centroid of the cobweb cluster at (0,3,6). max_distance=16 allows the player to spot them from the entrance area (spawn is at z=0, cobwebs start at z=5, so initial distance is ~7 blocks). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the cobwebs rather than away.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The tripwire hooks are on the walls at spawn-relative z=11 and z=13 at height y+1, past the archway dividing wall at z=9. Target is the centroid (0,1,12) between the two sets of hooks. max_distance=5 (tightened from 8 per ValidatorAgent feedback) ensures the player must be past the archway at z=9 and inside the trap room — from z=5 in the corridor the distance would be ~7 blocks which correctly fails. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the hooks.
